title: Landscape panoramas & long vistas
summary: Front-to-back sharpness for the big views — aperture sweet spot plus a focus trick.
why: Every lens is sharpest two-three stops down — for this kit, f/8. Focus a third into the scene (roughly the hyperfocal point) and depth of field covers from near foreground to the horizon. Diffraction past f/11 softens the whole frame.

steps.text: Mode dial to A, front dial to f/8
Move the focus point to something a third of the way in
For stitched panos: switch to M so every frame matches, overlap 30%
Level the horizon — the viewfinder grid is in Custom Setting d2

pitfalls: A tilted horizon costs crop on every frame of a stitch — level first, shoot second.
levelUp: Shoot panos vertical: 5–6 portrait frames stitch into a wider, taller, sharper file than one horizontal ever gets.
